title: Hadith on Good and Bad Deeds
summary: Prophet Muhammad emphasized removing harm from paths and cleanliness in mosques.
translation: Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said that the good and bad deeds of my community were presented to me. Among the good deeds, he found that removing harmful things from the path is considered a good deed, which Allah rewards greatly. As for bad deeds, he found that throwing nasal discharge or spitting in the mosque is bad. Such acts often happen out of forgetfulness, but people should avoid polluting the mosque, which must be kept clean not only outwardly but also free from actions we wouldn't do at home. Therefore, it's crucial to avoid such impurities as indicated by the Prophet (peace be upon him), because avoiding impurity is very important.
